recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future changes to Immunization refusal/statusReason semantics should be handled under current statusReason issues such as FHIR-54325, not by reopening this retired DSTU2 notGiven/notTaken relationship.
issue_request: FHIR-9073 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification DSTU2 Immunization request to clarify the relationship between status, notTaken/notGiven/wasNotGiven, and refusal reasons. Its final update closed the issue because R4 Event workflow alignment removed notGiven and added the not-done status.
initial_application: No FHIR-9073-tagged commit was found. The relevant R4 Immunization Event workflow history appears in commit 4c5a8902ab, which replaced the refused example's completed + notGiven representation with status not-done and added not-done to the status value set, followed by f451f3fc4b moving the refusal reason into statusReason.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively includes Immunization. The current StructureDefinition has no Immunization.notGiven, Immunization.wasNotGiven, or Immunization.notTaken element definitions; status is completed, entered-in-error, or not-done, and statusReason is constrained to not-done or entered-in-error. PHWG 2017-11-30 minutes record the notGiven/reasonNotGiven removal decision, a 2020 implementers Zulip thread confirms R4 refusal guidance, and later FHIR-54325 refines statusReason without restoring the retired elements.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current source already reflects the final FHIR-9073 decision and no source edit is needed.
